title: The Festival of the Uncaged Stair
description: Once each winter, the city opens its iron gates and lets the stairs reach across the courtyards. Neighbors take the short way over with pies and evergreen boughs.
alt: Neighbors in red coats carry a pie and evergreen boughs up a curving blue staircase suspended between snowy brick balconies.
pairing: Winter neighborhood feast × stairways that unfold
